_comment: Copy to roles/<role_id>.json. The roles/ directory is gitignored.
_scenario_note: Relocation-supported role: 'relocation_statement' uses 'generated_role_specific' so the resolver reads the verbatim 'relocation_statement' field on this role. Pair with a truthful 'availability_banner' for the openness slot.
title: Staff Platform Engineer
openness: Open to Dublin-based platform roles with relocation support.
_openness_note: Shown on the CV banner under the headline. Overrides profile.openness. Remove this key to inherit the profile-level default.

location_strategy._comment: Optional per-role override of profile.location_strategy_defaults. Same keys and values. Set 'inherit' to fall through to the profile-level default; omit a key to inherit implicitly. Supported values: inherit, hide, remote_label, current_residence, country_only, role_location, custom:<key>, generated_role_specific.

availability_banner: Available to start in Dublin within 8 weeks of offer.
_availability_banner_note: Optional. Rendered verbatim when 'location_strategy.availability_banner' is 'generated_role_specific'. Consumed by the resolver, not by cv_builder directly.
relocation_statement: Open to relocating to Dublin with employer-supported visa sponsorship.
_relocation_statement_note: Optional. Rendered verbatim as an extra line under the availability banner when 'location_strategy.relocation_statement' is 'generated_role_specific'.

paragraphs: Opening paragraph — specific hook to the platform team and Dublin office...
Paragraph 2 — relevant platform-engineering experience with concrete evidence...
Paragraph 3 — fit with the JD's requirements around reliability and developer experience...
Closing — confirm relocation timeline and availability.

experience_overrides._comment: Optional: override specific bullets for this role. Leave empty to use profile defaults.

notes: Relocation package confirmed on the JD; keep contact line truthful to current residence.
